subject: Deadline question
text: The schedule changed. A vendor canceled. We need the room. Please answer two things. Which deadline is firm? The client date or the board draft? I thought the draft came first. Today they said otherwise. This is confusing. I do not want to miss the client date. I also need to finish the draft. Please say which one matters most. Also tell me when I should switch tasks. I can push the other deadline. But I need to know. I need it by noon. If I do not hear from you, I will follow the client date. That was my first plan anyway. Does that work? Please confirm. I can work late tonight. I can skip the morning call. Just send one quick line now.
